## Overview

- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/get-started): Add PayPal Checkout to your integration so customers can pay using any funding source linked to their PayPal account - including PayPal balance, bank accounts, cards, and Pay…
- [Accept Payments](https://developer.paypal.com/braintree): Accept and process cards, wallets, and Local Payment Methods in a single, modern integration. Store customer and payment information to reduce friction at checkout.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/api): PayPal APIs use REST, authenticate with OAuth 2.0 access tokens, and return HTTP response codes and responses encoded in JSON.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/payments): Add Pay Later to a PayPal Checkout so customers can buy now and pay over time - while merchants get paid right away.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/revenue): Add the ability to create and send customized invoices to customers so they can review and pay through PayPal's secure payment page - with no manual follow-up required.
- [On this page](https://developer.paypal.com/developer-resources): Our JavaScript SDK brings PayPal, Venmo, Google Pay, Apple Pay, Fastlane, and card payments together in a single, modern integration - more secure and faster to ship than previous…
